CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (HONORARIA TO THE CHAIRMEN) RULES,
1966
CANTONMENT AREAS UNION COMMITTEES (HONORARIA TO THE CHAIRMEN) RULES, 1966
[Gazette of Pakistan, Part III, 30th September,
1966]
No. 1944/66.---In exercise of the
powers conferred by Article 89 of the Basic Democracies Order, 1959 (P.O. No.
18 of 1959), read with clause (6) of Article 12 thereof, the Central Government
is pleased to make the following rules, namely:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Cantonment Areas Union Committees
(Honoraria to the Chairmen) Rules, 1966.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Honorarium payable to Chairman of a Union Committee.--‑ (1) Subject to the provisions of this rule, the
Chairman of every Union Committee shall be paid an honorarium of Rs. 300 for every financial year during which he holds the
office.
(2) The honorarium shall be paid
in two half-yearly instalments.
(3) If the Chairman has held
office for a part only of the financial year he shall be paid such proportion
of the said amount as the period during which he has held office bears to year,
and if two or more Chairmen have held office during a financial year, each
Chairman shall be paid such proportion of the said amount as the period during
which he has held office bears to a year.
3. Honorarium to be paid out of Union Funds.---The
honorarium payable to the Chairman of a Union Committee shall be paid out of
the Union Fund of the Committee.
